hook: Brendan Foody is a co-founder and chief executive of Mercor, the San Francisco company that pays doctors, lawyers, bankers and engineers to train and test AI models for the major labs. Before Mercor he ran a cloud consulting business that saved corporate clients money on AWS and a short-lived compute startup, Seros, then left Georgetown in 2023 to build Mercor full time.
